a: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff stops MIME sniffing attacks.
Referrer-Policy limits sensitive URL data sent in Referer headers.
Permissions-Policy restricts browser features like camera and geolocation.
COOP helps isolate browsing contexts against cross-origin attacks.
CORP controls which origins can load your resources.
HSTS forces HTTPS for a domain for a set max-age.
CSP report-only logs violations without blocking while you tune policy.
CSP frame-ancestors replaces X-Frame-Options for clickjacking defense.
__Host- and __Secure- cookie prefixes enforce secure cookie attributes.
security.txt tells researchers how to report vulnerabilities.
